name: Image Colorizer
blurb: Upload a black-and-white image and get a colourised version in seconds.
about: Upload a black-and-white photograph and a model returns a colourised version in seconds. The frontend is static on Cloudflare Pages; the model runs as a separate Cloud Run service whose /colorize endpoint is origin-locked to this site, so the GPU work behind it can't be used as a free public API.
